messages.subject: SkylinetoMSstatsFormat precursors error
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm running into this error when I run SkylinetoMSstatsFormat():

Error in SkylinetoMSstatsFormat(data, annotation = NULL, removeiRT = TRUE,  : 
  Please check precursors information. If your experiment is DIA, please remove the precursors. If your experiments is DDA, please check the precursor information.

The experiment is DDA, I checked the precursors information, and under the Fragment Ion column, all of the rows indicate precursor (either precursor, precursor [M+1], precursor [M+2], or precursor -64).

Does anyone know of a solution?

Thank you!
Christina

messages.author: 99540594784b9805
messages.subject: Re: SkylinetoMSstatsFormat precursors error
parts:
"precursor-64" is not actually a precursor transition. That is a transition that is measured by fragmentation causing a 64 Dalton neutral loss to the precursor ion, so it gets measured in MS2.
If you get rid of the neutral loss transitions from your Skyline document, that will probably fix this error for you.

MSstats considers the following fragment ions to be "precursors":
precursor
precursor [M+1]
precursor [M+2]
If you have any other transitions in your document (including, probably incorrectly, things like "precursor [M+3]"), then MSstats will consider that the document contains things that are not precursors.

messages.subject: Re: SkylinetoMSstatsFormat precursors error
parts: Getting rid of the precursor-64 worked, thank you so much!
